name: dYdX V3
rootCause: Weekend wipeout. dYdX lost 40% of its v3's insurance fund ($9M) in a ‘targeted attack' involving manipulation of Yearn’s YFI token. One exploit, two losers.

descriptions.text: Weekend wipeout. dYdX lost 40% of its v3's insurance fund ($9M) in a ‘targeted attack' involving manipulation of Yearn’s YFI token. One exploit, two losers.

About $9m from the dYdX v3 insurance fund were used to fill gaps on liquidations processed in the YFI market, and the CEO said this was pretty clearly a targeted attack against dYdX, including market manipulation of the entire $YFI market.

On 18 November 2023, dYdX v3's insurance fund lost over $9 million on Ethereum following multi-day market manipulation centered on the YFI-USD market. The attacker used leveraged positions and external spot market price manipulation, resulting in massive undercollateralized positions and a fund shortfall. The protocol's price oracle relied on a liquidity-sensitive spot market index, allowing an attacker to inflate YFI's price, create large leveraged long positions, and then trigger mass liquidations and undercollateralized losses when the price crashed.
